items.title: Faster Quantum Algorithms with Agents and Formal Verification (4 minute read)
items.snippet: Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini 4 agents to find cheaper versions of known quantum algorithms, with each result proven correct in the Lean theorem prover. One circuit for fusion energy research cut its computing cost by 11.8x.

items.title: Claude Ship (3 minute read)
items.snippet: Claude Ship is a set of Anthropic agents that help get GitHub pull requests ready to merge. Code Review flags issues, PR Steward pushes fixes, and Claude Approvals checks changes against a team's approval policy.

items.title: GLM-5.4 (5 minute read)
items.snippet: Z.ai has released GLM-5.4, its first flagship model built on a Loop Transformer. The design reuses a shared block of layers to reason more deeply without adding parameters. Z.ai says it reaches intelligence comparable to 2T to 3T parameter models, and it is available now on the GLM Coding Plan.

items.title: I used to orchestrate agents. Now I orchestrate orchestrators (24 minute read)
items.snippet: MindRoom significantly enhances AI-driven coding by integrating multiple models in one room, efficiently managing up to forty concurrent sessions with seamless context switching. This approach, which utilizes minimal sub-agents, boosts productivity by maintaining low token overhead and offering a compact, card-based interface that organizes tasks by status.

items.snippet: Google's DeepCrossAttention (DCA) enhances transformer residual connections by allowing each layer to dynamically select and route features from preceding layers, reducing information dilution and parameter count by 30-40%. items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo (5 minute read)
items.snippet: Shirudo is an open-source runtime from OpenAI and Cisco that protects running Linux systems while teams roll out patches. It lets teams deploy temporary shields that block exploits without restarting the service.
